_README: Project defaults for broadridge visual checks (docs/broadridge-VISUAL-TESTING.md). Values here are used when the matching --flag is not passed on the CLI, so day-to-day you only pass --scope / --path / --block.

checks._README: CI only: which combos run on PRs. The matrix = enabled sources × enabled scopes. Local CLI runs ignore these (explicit --scope/--mode always run).
